candidate.input: two finite GROUND first-order term trees: atom={atom:symbol}; constructor={fun:symbol,args:[term,...]}
candidate.output: canonical least general common term with new var indices ordered first DFS disagreement, plus two finite reconstructing substitutions
candidate.behavior: preserve equal subtrees; recurse over equal constructor/arity; otherwise replace each ordered disagreement pair with a fresh variable, reusing variables for repeated equal disagreement pairs
candidate.falsifier: p(V0,V1) for p(a,a) and p(b,b) is common generalization but NOT least; differing occurrences should share V0
